methods.title: Materialized read-only inventory rows
methods.failure_signature: A first PowerShell path-inventory wrapper piped directly from a foreach block and failed to parse before reading state.
methods.candidate_workaround: Assign the foreach results to a named collection before piping to Format-Table.
methods.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell loop results before formatting.
methods.rollback: No state changed; retain the parser failure.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only inventory transport only; no domain or authority credit.

methods.title: Chunked complete skill reads
methods.failure_signature: Two combined skill-reading calls returned truncated projections before the selected files had been read completely.
methods.candidate_workaround: Read each selected instruction file separately and read the Method Flow schema in its own bounded call.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use file-sized output budgets and chunk only at file boundaries, never inside a selected SKILL.md.
methods.rollback: Treat truncated projections as unread; preserve them and use complete bounded reads.
methods.scope_boundary: Instruction-loading recovery only; no domain or authority credit.

methods.title: Inspect before exact patch context
methods.failure_signature: A narrow patch expected the x1 validation-summary manifest count to be 27, while the generated pre-manifest value was 26.
methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact generated object, then patch the observed scalar and refresh its manifest digest.
methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect generated context before applying a scalar patch.
methods.rollback: The failed patch changed no bytes; retain the failed attempt and exact correction.
methods.scope_boundary: Precommit metadata correction only; no domain or authority credit.

methods.title: Primary-source metadata fallback
methods.failure_signature: Three direct web opens were unusable: one publisher page returned 405, one journal page exposed only an iframe, and one DOI resolver was inaccessible.
methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed opens and use bounded search metadata that identifies the primary publication and DOI without claiming content inspection.
methods.recurrence_guard: Separate bibliographic metadata confirmation from full-text inspection and state which one occurred.
methods.rollback: Remove no source record; label direct opens failed and metadata-only recovery bounded.
methods.scope_boundary: Bibliographic terminology context only; no endorsement, artifact validation or scientific credit.
